item.title: Open-source workflow tool adds native AI agent nodes
item.description: A popular self-hosted workflow automation platform released agent nodes that can call tools, keep memory and hand off to human approval steps. Teams using n8n-style workflows can now mix deterministic steps with LLM decisions in one canvas.

item.title: Webhook reliability: retries, idempotency keys and dead-letter queues
item.description: A practical guide to making webhook integrations robust. It covers exponential backoff, idempotency keys to avoid duplicate orders, and routing failed events to a dead-letter queue for review.

item.title: Small businesses report time savings from invoice automation
item.description: A survey of 300 small firms found that automating invoice intake and approval saved finance teams an average of 6 hours per week. Most used a mix of OCR, LLM extraction and workflow automation.

item.title: RPA vendors pivot toward LLM-powered automation
item.description: Traditional robotic process automation vendors are adding LLM steps for unstructured inputs such as emails and PDFs, while keeping rule-based bots for structured data entry.
